chunks.context_title: Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission of Truth and Friendship
chunks.page_content: The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship sought to find the "conclusive truth" behind the events surrounding the 1999 independence referendum in East Timor. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship was a truth commission. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship handed in the final report on July 15, 2008. The final report of the Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship was fully endorsed by Indonesian President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship was established in August 2005. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship held private hearings. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship is notable for being the first modern truth commission to be bilateral. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship was established jointly by the governments of Indonesia and East Timor. The endorsement by Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono provided the first acknowledgement by the government of Indonesia of the human rights violations committed by state institutions in Timor. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship handed the final report to the presidents of Indonesia and East Timor. The acts of violence investigated by the Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship occurred around the independence referendum held in East Timor in 1999. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship was officially created to investigate acts of violence. The Indonesia–Timor Leste Commission on Truth and Friendship conducted document reviews.
